propositions: Add --retry CLI flag to resume only the latest eligible INDETERMINATE review by reusing checkpointed findings from success/resumed units and re-running failed/cancelled units plus budget-shed units under a fresh per-invocation attempt budget.

Validate latest review eligibility before any model call: refuse if result is not INDETERMINATE, journal is missing/legacy/corrupt/stale/digest-mismatched, or material/policy/prompts/contracts/model/mode/topology/context/dependencies/source have changed.

Reconstruct reusable unit content by recomputing checkpoint_identity digest from current lineage and loading stored CheckpointEnvelope findings; treat mismatched or absent envelopes as missing units to re-run.

Reuse clean and blocking successes as-is; run Pass-2 verification/coaching only for newly recovered findings; rerun deterministic decision, assembly, signature eligibility, and response rendering over combined results.
Make --retry mutually exclusive with --force, --status, and --check; keep --no-sign compatible; preserve unchanged normal review behavior without the flag.

Document --retry in canonical review-plan --help, cli-reference, user-guide, plan-review-gate, and exit-codes guides with eligibility, fresh budget, reuse/refusal semantics, flag interactions, and full-review remedy; exit with code 2 and print remedy to stderr on refusal.
